reviews.comment:
En los surtidires no se identifica cual visor son litros y cual es el precio. Cargue super. Me quisieron cobrar los litros cuando tenia que cobrarme lo del otro visor que en este caso era menor. A estar atentos.

(Translated by Google)
The pumps don't clearly indicate which display shows liters and which shows the price. I filled up with premium. They tried to charge me for liters when they should have charged me for the other display, which in this case showed a lower price. Be careful.
